devices.description: For information on how to obtain deviceId and localKey, go [here](https://github.com/hov3rcraft/eufy-robovac#readme).
devices.title: Devices

deviceIp.title: Device IP
deviceIp.description: If your device has a static IP, enter it here to improve performance.

useSwitchService.title: Use Switch for Vacuum (Legacy HAP Fallback Only)
useSwitchService.description: Only applies when Homebridge Matter is disabled. When Matter is enabled (Homebridge 2.0+), the vacuum is automatically exposed as a native Matter Robotic Vacuum Cleaner.

findButtonEnabled.title: Enable Find Button (Legacy HAP Fallback Only)
findButtonEnabled.description: Only applies when Homebridge Matter is disabled. In Matter mode, use the native Identify action.

batteryInformationEnabled.title: Enable Battery and Charging Information (Legacy HAP Fallback Only)
batteryInformationEnabled.description: Only applies when Homebridge Matter is disabled. In Matter mode, the PowerSource battery cluster is always enabled.

errorSensorEnabled.title: Enable Error Sensor (Legacy HAP Fallback Only)
errorSensorEnabled.description: Only applies when Homebridge Matter is disabled. In Matter mode, operational errors are natively reported via RvcOperationalState.

debugLogEnabled.title: Enable Debug Log
debugLogEnabled.description: Diverts the log messages for all log levels directly to the console
